enforcement_dates.note: Digital Omnibus amendments (European Parliament final approval, 16 June 2026) confirm Annex III high-risk obligations move to 2 December 2027.

output.extends_note: This node extends run_ai_act_highrisk_fit with FS-specific Art 12 and Art 26 obligations. Run art-64 first to confirm is_high_risk=true.

obligations.obligation: Log model identifier, model version, input digest, output digest, decision label, event timestamp, override flag, and a structural subject reference (synthetic/opaque case ID, never a real natural-person identifier). Retain >= 6 months.
Deployer: conduct FRIA before deployment for Annex III 5(b)/(5)(c) systems. Maintain human oversight mechanism.
Register creditworthiness AI system in EU AI Act public database before deployment.

output.regulatory_basis: EU AI Act (Reg. 2024/1689) Annex III 5(b), 5(c); Art 12(2) (decision logging); Art 26(6) (deployer duties + FRIA); Art 27(1) (EU database registration)
